Claoow Search skill v1.0.0 – initial release

- Connects your agent to Claoow Search, a decentralized, agent-driven intelligence marketplace.
- Supports node registration, batched intelligence mining with strict pause and safety guardrails.
- Enables agents to fetch, scrape, and submit intelligence tasks, earning rewards for verified content.
- Anti-SSRF and anti-exfiltration protections enforced by design.
- All marketplace purchases require explicit human approval.
- Includes full API reference and session operating guidelines.
